page_title: FRE 2-1 BOC | Freiburg v Bochum 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Freiburg are ruled offside.
90+5' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Reichel blows for a foul.
90+4' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
90+2' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The free kick into the penalty area from Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is cleared.
88' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vincenzo Grifo.

88' Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
88' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

87' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Freiburg manage to earn a corner.
86' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) trips an opposition player and Tobias Reichel signals a foul. Freiburg will take a free kick.
84' Substitution. Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) on for Danilo Teodoro Soares.
82' Here is a change. Ritsu Doan is going off and Christian Streich gives the last tactical orders to Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
82' Substitution. Noah Weisshaupt leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lukas Kubler (Freiburg).
78' The free kick from close range, taken by Bochum, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
77' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle and signals a foul after Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) brought his opponent down. Bochum have been awarded a free kick.
77' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
75' The substitution has been made. Lukas Daschner (Bochum) has replaced Anthony Losilla.
75' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Philipp Forster (Bochum) replaces Kevin Stoger.
73' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Roland Sallai is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).
73' Here comes a substitution. Maximilian Philipp is given a rest as he is replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).

72' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Manuel Riemann pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner.
70' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
66' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Noah Atubolu sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
65' Thomas Letsch decides to make a substitution. Cristian Gamboa will be replaced by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
65' Goncalo Paciencia will be replaced by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).
65' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) is cautioned by the referee.
63' The booking goes to Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
62' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
62' The ball goes out of play and Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
61' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Takuma Asano (Bochum) tries a shot from distance, but the goalkeeper can stay calm as it goes high over the crossbar.
56' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
56' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot well wide of the left post.

55' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
53' One of the players from Freiburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) is given a yellow card.
51' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Noah Atubolu intercepts the ball.

48' This would have been a magnificent goal from Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the right post.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45+5' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+2' 2 - 1 Goal! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Riemann into the top right corner.
45+2' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+1' Bernardo (Bochum) handles the ball inside the penalty area. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Freiburg.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Manuel Riemann, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
42' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
40' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) smashes the ball towards goal with a volley from close-range, but the goalkeeper uses his incredible reflexes to make a brilliant save.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.

39' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

36' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches over the bar.
31' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Reichel had an easy-decision to make.
31' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) hits a long-range volley without any hesitation towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows good anticipation and makes a save.
29' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
28' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
26' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Vincenzo Grifo sends a long raking pass onto the head of Ritsu Doan (Freiburg), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
25' 1:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 0:2.
24' Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Reichel didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Bernardo (Bochum) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
21' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
21' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) jumps into a tackle and Tobias Reichel signals a foul. It's a free kick to Freiburg, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
19' This shall not pass! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
19' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

18' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block. Bochum earn a corner.

15' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) fires a brilliant volley inside the right post from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Takuma Asano provided the assist. What a finish! 0:1.
14' The corner kick from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
12' Bernardo (Bochum) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
12' Anthony Losilla (Bochum) will take the corner.
11' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bochum.

8' Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
8' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
6' Takuma Asano (Bochum) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
3' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
3' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a long ball in, but Noah Atubolu comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bochum will have the kick-off.
Tobias Reichel will officiate today.
